numeric_contract.dtype: IEEE754 binary64 round-to-nearest additions/subtractions; no fast-math/FMA/reassociation.
numeric_contract.fixed_algorithm: Each5-term sum starts with the first difference and performs4 additions. Four legs use20 subtractions+16 additions; composing two relative differences andS adds3 operations=39. Direct endpoint expression adds3 subtractions and residual comparison1, giving43 operations.
numeric_contract.L1: Sum absolute values of all44 cached-log leaf occurrences in theS andendpoint computation graphs, including repeated occurrences.
numeric_contract.acceptance: abs(S-S_endpoint)<=gamma43*L1+43*eta. Apply the same conservative43-operation bound with the appropriate leaf list to each per-asset D_i+N_i endpoint identity.
numeric_contract.log_boundary: Cached corrected log values are treated as the shared input constants in this algebraic check. No assumption of correctly-rounded libm log is needed to prove cancellation on those same constants. This does not certify true-price accuracy, common economic basis or statistical usefulness.
numeric_contract.no_rescue: No outcome-conditioned multiplier, minimum economic floor, relaxed tolerance or repeat until passing.
